question: The value of sqrt{196}+sqrt{0.0324}-sqrt{6.76}=
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify the base square roots first: √196 = 14, √324 = 18, and √676 = 26.

Adjust for decimals by halving the decimal places in the square root.

√0.0324 (4 decimal places) becomes 0.18 (2 decimal places).

√6.76 (2 decimal places) becomes 2.6 (1 decimal place).

Solve: 14 + 0.18 − 2.6 = 14.18 − 2.6 = 11.58.

**∴ The correct answer is 11.58.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The expression is: √196 + √0.0324 − √6.76

**Method Used:**

Convert decimal values into fractions to easily calculate their exact square roots.

**Calculations:**

⇒ √196 + √(324 ÷ 10000) − √(676 ÷ 100)

⇒ 14 + (18 ÷ 100) − (26 ÷ 10)

⇒ 14 + 0.18 − 2.6

⇒ 14.18 − 2.6

⇒ 11.58

**∴ The correct answer is 11.58.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Decimal Square Roots

If a perfect square has 2n decimal places, its exact square root will have exactly n decimal places.

BODMAS Rule

Always follow the strict order of operations for simplifications: Bracket, Order (powers and roots), Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction.

Common Squares

Memorizing perfect squares up to 30 accelerates calculation speed. For example: 24² = 576, 25² = 625, and 26² = 676.
